entries.title: T6 全局前沿的既有 p19 进展与 p17 齐次 q0 排除
entries.typed_carrier: External arithmetic/finite algebra or explicitly conditional circuit on full X6; no native-plane or physical upgrade
assumptions: 整数分母 a=e+1≥2；全七个观察 H0,…,H6；共同原子先相消；两侧指数质量各≤2331。
p19/p17 分层在最大素因子选择后进行，保留所有合数坐标；p19 旧低阶输入按其原来源消费。

formulas.name: shape/reciprocal observer
formulas.formula: H_k=Σ_e (e/(e+1))^k; a=e+1; equality H_0,…,H_6 ⇔ equality Σ_a z_a a^{-k}=0 for k=0,…,6 (binomial triangular change).

formulas.name: q0 static exclusion
formulas.formula: u≠0 in L_17 ⇒ ||Wu||²≥min_i D_i>2·2331²=10867122; feasible q0 would have ||Wu||²≤10867122.

conclusions: p17 估值≥2被排除，非零齐次 q0 在必要球外；这是具有独立静态重构支持的局部证明。
p19 六个高阶块及旧低阶依赖组成作者报告的完整 p19 层排除；70,285,694 是作者冻结实例计数，当前整理不新增独立穷举认证。
non_applicability: RR 原文 NEGATIVE_BOUNDARY / PARTIAL_PROGRESS 不改为全局 SATISFIED；正式 DR 是 RETURN_TO_OWNER、terminal=false。
T6=2332、较低最大素因子、H0 完整碰撞及未完成 p17 阶仍未由本条证明。
旧(3,6) builder 档案缺失仍保留；后来有另一份作者侧有界验证，不叫找回原程序。

status.author: EM-T6SM-B134BD
status.unresolved_residue_literal: Global T6=2332 is unproved; maximal p17 vertical orders1..16 and lower maximal primes remain. Original prior (3,6) builder archive is missing, but its bounded conclusion has a new independent exact verification.
status.interpretation: Frozen author wording and later genuine DR are separate chronological facts; only the stated bounded scope is carried over.

entries.read_scope: Full primary mathematical manuscript and substantive review narrative read; archived programs and experimental logs are documentary evidence, not rerun.

entries.title: p17 总阶1–4 的已接受有限分类
entries.typed_carrier: External arithmetic/finite algebra or explicitly conditional circuit on full X6; no native-plane or physical upgrade
assumptions: p17 估值一外部原子：q≥1、1≤r≤16，分母17(17q+r)，质量289q+17r−1；总阶 t=Σq，按两侧重数计。
同一(q,r)跨侧先消去；同侧可重复；primitive 仅指消去规范化，不要求重数 gcd=1；只商整体变号。

formulas.name: separate signed budgets and necessary sphere
formulas.formula: Σ_jw_j max(u_j,0)≤P; Σ_jw_j max(−u_j,0)≤N ⇒ Σ_j(w_ju_j)²≤R²=P²+N².

formulas.name: full kernel, affine norm
formulas.formula: L_17 has index17^21; a verified unit six-column minor and |detU|=17^21 prove saturation; ||W(u0+Σ_i z_i U_i)||²=Σ_i D_i(z_i+c_i)².

conclusions: q1仅十二个实际域类 EMPTY、四个 OUTSIDE；q2全272、q3全3264、q4全30992指定 literal 系统 EMPTY。
四条均已有真正 Source 固定 RR 与后续 ACCEPTED、terminal=true 的 DR；闭合范围均为对应有限 Task。
q2-1 与其余271正确合并；q3双路径同文只录一次；q4使用新 canonical particular 与新二进制证书，旧q3不改写。
